description.html: Take notes and write down your to-do lists in these colorful Yoobi college ruled spiral notebooks. This bundle comes in 3 different colors, one for each subject to help you stay organized! Each notebook comes with 150 three-hole punched perforated sheets to tear out cleanly and easily. Plus, it includes an interior paper pocket to help all your loose papers! YOU BUY, YOOBI GIVES - For every Yoobi item you purchase, a Yoobi item will be donated to a child in need, right here in the U.S. Product Details 3-Pack of 3-subject notebook 150 sheets each Perfect for school, home or office College ruled, 3-hole punched perforated sheets Includes interior paper pocket Paper size: 8" x 10.5" Notebook Dimensions (with Spiral): 0.4" x 8.85" x 10.63" Colors: Blush, Mint, Blue

Choose from our collection of college-ruled and wide-ruled notebooks, each designed to take with you on the go. Write it all down in a cute composition book with lined sheets, tear out that to-do list with the spiral notebook’s perforated edges, and make your desk notes pop with a mini notebook that’s colors and patterns reflect the uniqueness of you.

Looking to stock up on school or office essentials? Yoobi's bundled items have you covered! Choose from our colorful pen sets, complete with gel, ballpoint, and felt-tip options. Love pencils? Grab a bundle that includes No. 2 pencils, sharpeners, and erasers, so you're always prepared. Highlight key points with our vibrant highlighters, and bring your creativity to life with bold markers. Keep everything organized with our adorable pencil pouches—perfect for storing all your favorite supplies in one place. With Yoobi bundles, you’ll have everything you need to stay creative and organized!

Looking for supplies for school, home or the office? Notebooks are probably on the list! Choose from spiral notebooks, composition books and fun, glittery journals. Spiral notebooks are college-ruled and composition books are available in college ruled and wide ruled. There are basic solid colors and fun prints as well.

Not sure which Yoobi products to buy? All of our products help children in need, so you can't go wrong! There are so many fun and colorful school supplies to choose from, and these are our customers' favorites! Choose from colorful notebooks to binders, gel pens, markers and highlighters. Dont' forget a cute pencil case to store these in too! And for those Marvel fans, we have lots of fun school supplies featuring your favorite super hero, including Spider-Man, Captain American and other Avengers.

Bring your sweet tooth to school with you in the form of this notebook set!
